sub: Teach facts to ANIMA — and ANIMA deduces new ones.
addhint: ANIMA learns this fact on the device; ask it back in your own words.
relhint: Link two entities: ANIMA learns the relation AND deduces the facts that follow.
dedhint: Facts you never told ANIMA, deduced from your relations (deterministic logic, no guessing). Teach them and ANIMA will remember them.
profhint: Deterministic personal data: ANIMA recalls these exactly (name, age, city…).
askprof: What does ANIMA know about me?
p.name: Name
empty: No facts yet. Add a fact or a relation above.
needboth: Enter a subject and a value.
volatile: ANIMA won’t store it: looks temporary (today/now/weather…).
failteach: ANIMA could not learn it now.
noded: Add more relations (e.g. two parents, or two linked places) and deductions will appear here.
listhint: {n}/128 facts teachable to ANIMA. Beyond that the device forgets the oldest (this list stays).
